name: Guangzhou Baiyun Electric Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Guangzhou Baiyun Electric Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sale, and service of capacitors, transformers, switchgear, frequency converters, automatic control, intelligent components, and other products in China and internationally. The company provides high voltage GIS, medium voltage C-GIS, medium voltage metal enclosed switchgear, ring main unit, DC traction switchgear, low voltage switchgear, distribution box, intelligent bus, medium voltage switch, low voltage switch, and intelligent components.
